name: Mime Jr.

attacks.name: Mime-y Shuffle
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw a card for each card in your opponent’s hand.

flavor:
It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer
and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps
like an apprentice.
